engineeringGate: 902 unique product tests and targeted browser paths have pass evidence; full fixed-code CI/E2E live, acceptance not granted

matrix.pairing: 每个情境/提供商/重复单独生产一个冻结 release；六种行为从该 release 的同一初始状态创建独立会话，不共享运行记忆。两次重复重新生产。
matrix.order: core scenarios in listed order, then holdouts; provider slots independently runnable; repeat 1 before 2; behaviors in listed order
matrix.productionFailure: 保留该生产单元及其六个 production-blocked episode 槽位；不重抽开场，不以未运行冒充通过。运行质量仅对实际运行报告，端到端分母保留全部计划槽位。

budget.stopCheck: 每次新触发前检查预算，已发请求只观察到终态；上限含审查/局面/发现调用，不把玩家输入次数冒充调用次数。正常产品有界链可能越过软 token 上限一次，记录实际值，不悄悄继续。

changes: New implementation and source reader/reviewer contracts since original cohort
Author explicitly enables allowActorThreadFollowups, all other permissions follow current DEFAULT_CHAT_SETTINGS_V3
Core author materials, original-order first passing opening selection, player policy, budgets and scoring criteria unchanged

models.transport: local subscription bridge; no paid API fallback
models.effectiveSampling: bridge request accepts model/messages/output schema only; app temperature and maxTokens are not passed to Codex; retain actual request and usage, do not claim controlled sampling

models.condition: 在此槽位首次调用之前追加配置修订，冻结实际模型、采样、预算及连接核验；不得用历史模型记录代替当次配置。

limitations: Collection is scripted, not a real human participant or independent quality assessment
Agnes configuration remains unavailable; no substitute provider
No holdout material opened or used to tune this run
Local isolated author material, formal S3 production and local ProductRelease only; no online publication

productionUnits.openingSelection: first candidate in original order; all required checks passed

collectionSetupErrors.reason: Navigation checked New Session visibility before rendering and then waited for an inapplicable panel button
collectionSetupErrors.resolution: Wait for observed New Session button; reuse exact release; runtime-only script separately hash-bound

latency.measure: durable runtime createdAt to last updatedAt; includes action and review, not first feedback or token latency; excludes operator think time

episodeCollection.classificationOwner: implementer applying preregistered collection stopping rule; not independent human scoring
episodeCollection.classificationEvidence: 第9次玩家输入后，角色已提出只看外观且承认不能据此判断机芯。随后第10至12次输入对应的三个回复分别重述不预定修法/接受暂不做、等待决定、外观不足以判断内部，未新增可执行选择、具体线索或行动后果；这些理由已在第1/3/9次回复说明。依预登记重复停止规则结束，保留等待许可及未完成修钟事项。此判断为实现者的采集分类，不是独立真人评分，也不把尊重未授予许可本身当作越权修复依据。
limitations: The player deliberately deferred all inspection consent, then continued the frozen brief-response cycle. Respecting that pending choice is not itself a product defect.

Early replies added scope and value tradeoffs, and opportunity 9 offered external inspection only. Opportunities 10-12 restated already expressed caution/waiting; this semantic stopping classification remains open to independent review.
Unlike the V60 concrete path, this path never consented to the actor-proposed inspection. Same policy text does not make these trajectories a controlled before/after comparison.
All 13 action and review runs completed technically; protocol collection ending and provider completion do not mean story completion.
No holdout material, human rating, second-provider result, or competitive/commercial acceptance was added.

countSemantics: collectionCompleted counts a protocol terminal collection, including failure; it is independent of narrativePassed/humanScored. The original cohort retains its original counts and records.
next: Preserve this failed slot and the original cohort; collect the next preregistered refuse behavior as an independent session from the same frozen release. Do not change prompts, code, selection or thresholds within the cohort.
